📖 *STX AI Usage*

• Type a ticker: `AAPL`, `$TSLA`, `0700\.HK`
• Ask for analysis: `NVDA technicals?`
• Use the keyboard below for quick actions

*Buttons:*
📈 Analyze — Deep multi\-agent report
⚡ Signal — Quick trading signal
📰 News — Latest headlines
📊 US/HK Scan — Market movers

Supports US & Hong Kong stocks\.

`/pair <code>`
